text:
maya-partners: Quick check on CloudStore joint launch with TeraEdge. Target publish Mon 6/5. Need final marketplace tile, co-announcement blurb, and localized landing (EN/JP).

leo-product: We need SKU mapping and meters. Proposed SKUs: TE-EDGE-BASE, TE-EDGE-PRO. Meter slug: teraedge.instance.hour.

rachel-press: Press wants an embargo window Mon 6/5 08:00 PT. Need partner-approved quote + CEO quote by Fri EOD. Also want 2-3 blur-safe screenshots.

taro-si: SI integration fine on staging. Outstanding: sample terraform snippet and runbook for onsite installers. I'll draft tf example.

ben-eng: Packaging note  the start-up env var for GPU passthrough needs update. PR 901 will address it tonight.

sara-legal: Remove phrase "zero downtime" from copy. Add data-location selector for EU customers. I'll add approved wording.

ash-creative: I'll produce hero image + thumbnail. Where to place assets?

maya-partners: Drop assets in /shared/marketplace/teraedge. Tag me when uploaded.

leo-product: Also confirm co-announcement format: joint blog + short social thread. Partner marketing to provide 1-2 lines for co-post.

taro-si: Terraform snippet (use in docs):

```
provider "redwood" {
  region = "ap-northeast-1"
}

resource "redwood_instance" "tera" {
  sku    = "TE-EDGE-PRO"
  region = "ap-northeast-1"
}
```

notify-bot: Calendar event created: "TeraEdge CloudStore Rehearsal" Fri 6/2 09:00 PT. link: https://cal.example/tera-rehearsal

rachel-press: I'll draft PR and FAQ. Need the partner quote by Fri 3pm PT.

sara-legal: Posted approved EU residency blurb in doc: https://docs.example/legal/eu-residency. Use exact text.

maya-partners: Action recap: Leo  finalize SKUs+meter (today). Ash  upload hero (Thu AM). Ben  merge PR 901 (tonight). Taro  terraform + runbook (Thu EOD). Rachel  PR + embargo (Fri). Sara  legal blurbs (done). Rehearsal Fri 6/2. Flag blockers here. :shipit:
